title: OpenSER in Cisco Service Node for Linksys One
html:
OpenSER gets CISCO’s vote of confidence as the SIP proxy of Cisco Service Node for Linksys One…

OpenSER along with other premier Open Source software – FreeBSD, PostgreSQL and BIND – run on Cisco Service Node servers.

http://www.cisco.com/en/US/products/ps7194/products_data_sheet0900aecd805c3cc1.html

(local PDF cache)

Day by day new public disclosures show OpenSER widely used by big companies and academic institutes, following the early adopters like Voztelecom, Truphone, BASIS Audionet, VoIPUser, MIT, INRIA…

All these give one more vote of confidence to OpenSER, ranking its stability, flexibility and capabilities to an appreciated level.
